set.body:
Outcome
Prove generic provider compatibility before Meridian consumes the candidate.

Owned scope
build.sbt; CI/runtime test configuration; fx/core tests; docs/styling.md; provider evidence

Prerequisites
S1, S2, S3, S4, S5

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Run required formatting/compile/core/fx regression checks on exact candidate, including JDK22/JavaFX24.0.1 floor and JDK25/JavaFX27. Runtime jars/classifiers are coherent and recorded.
- [ ] Tests actually execute JavaFX27 interaction code; compiling a 27 demo with FX tests still using 24 is insufficient.
- [ ] Cover pane identity, persisted layouts/perspectives, async close admission, custom scheme, metric/hit-test updates, live popups, keyboard and custom motion.
- [ ] Independent reviewer records candidate SHA, API/selector compatibility verdict, commands/exits, native evidence and open limitations.
- [ ] Publish the receipt locally to this issue and reference it from Meridian @B0@; leave source publication/runtime upgrades of other applications outside scope.

Required evidence
Existing commands: sbt scalafmtCheckAll compile test; floor core/test fx/test; add and document a real 27 test lane before claiming it ran. Keep raw logs and native manifests.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
../meridianfx/PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code S6. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [S6] Qualify the provider on both runtime lanes and issue an independent receipt
